results.content:
Apple will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on Wednesday, September 9, but this year’s pre-order schedule could look slightly different from the familiar pattern Apple customers have come to expect.

Normally, Apple opens pre-orders on the Friday immediately following its September event. Following that pattern in 2026 would put iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders on Friday, September 11, but there is a strong reason to expect Apple to wait an extra day. [...] There is historical precedent. Apple unveiled the iPhone 6s and iPhone 6s Plus on Wednesday, September 9, 2015. Rather than opening pre-orders on Friday, September 11, Apple waited until Saturday, September 12.
